scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the stochastic model, the definition of the auxiliary Lyapunov weight and noise lower bound, equation (9), Theorem 4.4 and its proof, and the Section 6.3 extinction example. The theorem and parameter-table pages were visually inspected. A closely related earlier stochastic SEIRS paper was inspected for implication comparison. The repaired criterion is derived analytically and replayed by a bundled numerical checker. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The repaired inequality is necessary and sufficient for feasibility of the source's coefficientwise logarithmic Lyapunov certificate, not for extinction of the stochastic model by every possible method. The numerical replay uses rounded parameters printed in the article and does not reconstruct unpublished simulation code.

title: A noncircular stochastic extinction certificate for a cholera model
